description: This file defines a PHP controller class 'LanguageTranslationController' within the OrangeHRM system. It handles pre-render logic for language translation editing, including fetching language data based on request attributes and configuring a Vue component for the frontend.

classes.name: LanguageTranslationController
classes.description: A controller handling the pre-render process for language translation editing in the admin interface. It initializes a Vue component with relevant language data and handles access validation.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering by fetching language details based on request attributes and configuring a Vue component with properties such as language ID, package name, and source language. Throws an exception if the language is not found or disabled.
